overview_description.description:
Zeroheight is a software company developing a design documentation platform to easily build style guides and reuse common design elements. Its platform offers an easy-to-create design system to edit style guides that are synced with design and code to create beautiful and sophisticated style guides.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in London, England.

about_short_description.short_description: zeroheight is a DevOps platform that allows design teams to create up-to-date style guides and document their design system resources.

product.name: Design System Documentation
product.description: Tools to create and manage design system documentation, including templates, customizable blocks, and an easy-to-use editor.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: In-built integrations with design and development tools like Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Storybook, GitHub, and more.

product.name: Design Tokens
product.description: Automated delivery from design to code using design tokens.

product.name: Live Components
product.description: Import and render live components from frameworks like React and Angular directly in documentation.

product.name: Collaboration and Governance
product.description: Features for versioning, managing multiple design systems, gathering feedback, and syncing elements across styleguides.

product.name: Security Features
product.description: Enterprise-level security settings including SSO, IP white-listing, and SOC2 compliance.
